Q: What is birdseye wool, and why does it work so well in tailoring?
A: Birdseye wool is a micro-patterned suiting fabric woven with tiny contrasting dots that create subtle depth and texture. From afar it reads clean and polished; up close it has a bit more to say for itself.
Why is it good for tailoring? Because it does the smart bit without being flat or fussy. The texture helps disguise daily wear, holds up well, and gives classic tailoring a little more character.
